svg.aria-label: Gate mutation adequacy: 19 deliberate weakenings seeded into a release gate's own configuration, of which the gate caught 9 (47.4%). Every mutant in the weaken_threshold, perturb_wording classes survived, leaving the gate reporting a clean release.
